Terms.title: TERMS & CONDITIONS
Terms.subtitle: What you agree to when you buy from erlume.

buyerCards.title: Authenticity
buyerCards.body: Every item is authenticated before listing. If an item is later shown not to be authentic, we refund you in full, including delivery.

buyerCards.title: Returns
buyerCards.body: Returns are accepted within 14 days of delivery. See our Returns & Refunds policy for the full details.

buyerCards.title: Condition Grading
buyerCards.body: Every item is graded New, Like New, Gently Used, Fair or Worn, and photographed as received. The grade and the photographs form part of the description you are purchasing against.

buyerCards.title: Pre-Loved Items
buyerCards.body: Items are second-hand unless stated otherwise. Minor signs of wear consistent with the stated grade are expected and are not grounds for return.

buyerCards.title: Ordering & Payment
buyerCards.body: All orders are placed and paid in full on the website. We accept KNET, cards and Apple Pay. An order is confirmed only once payment clears, and you receive a confirmation email with your invoice attached.

buyerCards.title: Delivery
buyerCards.body: Delivery fees are shown before payment and are charged in addition to the item price. We currently deliver within Kuwait only.

buyerCards.title: Item Reservation
buyerCards.body: If payment is not completed, the item returns to sale and may be purchased by someone else. Every item is one of a kind — a completed payment is the only reservation.

buyerCards.title: Drops
buyerCards.body: Items in an upcoming drop are not purchasable until that drop opens. Drop timing may change.

buyerCards.title: Discount Codes
buyerCards.body: Codes apply to the item price only, not to delivery, and cannot be combined unless stated otherwise.

buyerCards.title: Pricing Errors
buyerCards.body: If an item is listed at an obviously incorrect price, we may cancel the order and refund you in full rather than fulfil it.

useCards.title: Using the Site
useCards.body: You may browse and purchase for personal use. You may not scrape, copy or republish our listings, photographs or descriptions without permission.

useCards.title: Content Ownership
useCards.body: All photographs, descriptions and site content belong to erlume.

useCards.title: Accounts
useCards.body: You are responsible for activity on your account, so keep your details accurate and your login secure. Some actions need email verification. You can delete your account at any time, and we may suspend accounts used fraudulently, abusively, or in breach of these terms.

useCards.title: Reviews
useCards.body: Reviews must be your own honest experience. We may remove reviews that are abusive, false, or unrelated to the item.

useCards.title: Availability
useCards.body: We aim to keep the site available but do not guarantee uninterrupted service.

useCards.title: Changes to These Terms
useCards.body: We may update these terms. The version that applies to an order is the version published when that order was placed.

useCards.title: Governing Law
useCards.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Kuwait.

useCards.title: Disputes
useCards.body: We would rather resolve problems directly — contact us first and we will try to settle it. Any dispute that cannot be resolved will be subject to the courts of Kuwait.

Returns.title: RETURNS & REFUNDS
Returns.subtitle: You have 14 days from delivery to change your mind.

cards.title: 14 Days to Return
cards.body: Tell us within 14 days of receiving your item if you would like to return it. Items must come back in the condition they were sent, with all packaging and inclusions.

cards.title: Not as Described
cards.body: If an item differs materially from its listed condition, its photographs, or its authenticity, we cover the return delivery and refund you in full.

cards.title: Change of Mind
cards.body: Where a return is accepted for any other reason, return delivery is at your cost and the original delivery fee is not refunded.

cards.title: Refund Timing
cards.body: Refunds are issued to your original payment method, normally within 3 to 14 business days of the item being received and inspected.

cards.title: Cancelled or Expired Checkouts
cards.body: An unpaid checkout is released automatically. If a payment arrives after an order has been cancelled, it is refunded automatically, so there is no need to contact us.

cards.title: Authenticity
cards.body: Every item is authenticated before listing. If an item is later shown not to be authentic, we refund you in full including delivery.

cards.title: Pre-Loved Items
cards.body: Items are second-hand unless stated otherwise. Minor signs of wear consistent with the stated grade are expected and are not grounds for return.

cards.title: Starting a Return
cards.body: Email info@erlume.com.kw or message +965 97226735 with your order number, and we will arrange collection.

SellerPolicy.title: SELLING POLICY
SellerPolicy.subtitle: Everything you need to know before listing with erlume.
SellerPolicy.criteriaSubtitle: Items that don't meet these criteria won't be listed, and we'll arrange to return them to you. Please review before submitting.
criteria: Clean, free of odours, stains or visible dirt
Not torn, broken, or damaged beyond repair
A bag — we only accept bags
Complete — straps, buckles and zippers intact, no missing parts
Functional — the bag must open and close properly
Free of broken clasps, missing stones or structural damage
Material type disclosed (leather, fabric, metal), with sizing included where applicable
Original box or pouch is preferred but not required

fees.title: Logistics & handling
fees.body: 2.5% added to the buyer price — not deducted from you

fees.title: Collection
fees.body: 3–5 KWD, by erlume driver or third-party courier

cards.title: Written Quote
cards.body: You receive a written quote before handing anything over, showing the estimated listing price, our commission, and your payout. Nothing proceeds without your acceptance.

cards.title: Ownership & Warranty
cards.body: You confirm that the item is yours to sell, is free of any claim by another party, and is genuine. You remain the owner of the item until it is sold.

cards.title: Commission
cards.body: 25% of the item’s assessed value, deducted from the sale proceeds. Your quote states the exact amount in KWD.

cards.title: Logistics & Handling
cards.body: A 2.5% logistics & handling charge is added to the buyer-facing price. This is not deducted from your payout.

cards.title: Collection
cards.body: We collect your items before the drop opens. Collection costs between 3 and 5 KWD.

cards.title: Authentication & Verification
cards.body: All items are authenticated. We reserve the right to decline any item we cannot verify. Counterfeit items result in account suspension and forfeiture of earnings.

cards.title: Prohibited Items
cards.body: No illegal, hazardous, recalled or legally restricted items. We may remove a listing without notice.

cards.title: Care While With Us
cards.body: We take reasonable care of your item while it is in our possession for cleaning, photography and storage. If an item is lost or damaged while with us, we compensate you at the payout value stated on your accepted quote.

cards.title: Photography & Listing
cards.body: Items are cleaned, photographed and listed by erlume, and we determine how they are presented. Photographs taken by erlume remain our property and we may continue to use them after the item is sold or returned.

cards.title: Pricing
cards.body: Prices are set by our valuation method — brand tier, age, condition and comparable sold prices — rather than negotiated per item.

cards.title: Payout
cards.body: Your share is transferred once the buyer’s payment has cleared and the return window has passed (14 days).

cards.title: How Long We List For
cards.body: Your item stays listed for its drop and continues afterwards while we work to sell it — a drop can run longer than a month.

cards.title: Uncollected Items
cards.body: If we cannot reach you to return an item, we will contact you at your registered details. Items uncollected six months after they become due may be donated.

cards.title: Your Details
cards.body: We do not share your contact details with buyers. All communication goes through erlume.

cards.title: Policy Changes
cards.body: We may update these terms at any time. You will be notified of any material change.

CookiesPolicy.title: COOKIES POLICY
CookiesPolicy.subtitle: Learn about how we use cookies to enhance your experience on our platform.

cards.title: What Cookies Are
cards.body: Small files a site stores in your browser so it can recognise you between pages and visits.

cards.title: Essential Cookies
cards.body: Required for the site to work — keeping you signed in, remembering your cart, and completing payment. These cannot be switched off.

cards.title: Analytics
cards.body: If used, analytics cookies help us understand how the site is used. They are optional and you may decline them.

cards.title: Managing Cookies
cards.body: You can clear or block cookies in your browser. Blocking essential cookies will prevent checkout from working.

cards.title: Cookie Duration
cards.body: Session cookies are cleared when you close your browser. Persistent cookies remain until they expire or you delete them.

cards.title: Third-Party Cookies
cards.body: Some cookies are set by the services we use rather than by erlume directly, such as our payment provider during checkout.

cards.title: Changes to This Policy
cards.body: We may update this policy. Changes are posted on this page with an updated effective date.

CookiesPolicy.ctaBody: If you have any questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at <mail>{email}</mail>

About.title: ABOUT ERLUME
About.subtitle: Every piece carries a story.
story: Erlume is Kuwait's curated destination for pre-loved treasures where every piece carries a story. We're a trusted community dedicated to buying and selling quality, pre-loved bags in a kind and respectful way.

Our mission is to offer a sustainable and stylish alternative to fast fashion, while creating a supportive space for both buyers and sellers. Whether you're searching for a unique find or a new home for a cherished piece, Erlume helps you make a meaningful impact — one beautiful bag at a time.
